How to use the kit? Magnesium Gummies: Take one gummy post meal, 1-2 hours before bed. Magnesium Lotion: Disperse product across feet, soles, legs, arms, neck, shoulder and massage it in for a few seconds for full absorption. Use it post heavy workout or before going to bed. Caution To see a noticeable difference in you, it is recommended that you use these Magnesium Gummies regularly and consistently for 3-4 months. We suggest taking a doctor's consultation before incorporating it in your routine. These gummies won't cause any reactions, if it does, please stop using them and consult a doctor before adding them back to your routine.
